`calc.js` is copied unchanged from
[ALENZACODES/private-credit-screener](https://github.com/ALENZACODES/private-credit-screener),
which is released under the MIT licence (see the LICENSE file in that repository). The tests in
`code/ch06/test_crosschecks.py` run it with Node.js and compare its grades and metrics with the
Python port in `ch06lib.py`.
